descriptionChirho: A masculine plural noun denoting fragrant spices or aromatic substances used in the preparation of sacred incense and anointing oil (Exod 25:6; 30:23-34; 35:8, 28; 37:29; 1 Chr 9:29-30; 2 Chr 2:3; Song 4:10, 14, 16; 8:14). All 16 occurrences refer to the same category of aromatic materials; the only difference is the presence or absence of the definite article. Multilingual evidence: eng 'spices / the spices', spa 'especias / las especias', arb 'عِطْرٍ / العِطرِ', kor '향품들 / 그 향품들', swa 'manukato / wenye manukato', hin 'सुगंधित / सुगंधित के'.
